text.tspan: Complete 50-task runs only; partial seeds are excluded rather than averaged in. Bold is the best value in each column.
Values are the mean over each method's complete seeds with ±1 s.d. across them.
Complete seeds: DUEL 3, CKA-RL 3, CbpNet 3, CReLUs 3, Fine-tuning 3, From-scratch 3.
Forward transfer is measured against the from-scratch run, which is therefore 0 by construction.
